units.source_text: 男人用相同的步调缓缓前行。

en.t: The man slowly walked forward at the same pace.

units.source_text: 每踏出一步，沙子便涌上来，流到鞋子上。

en.t: With each step he took, the sand welled up and flowed over his shoes.

units.source_text: 只要有适当的湿度，一天就会发芽的杂草，随处叉开它那浅浅的根。

en.t: Weeds that would sprout in a single day with the right amount of moisture spread their shallow roots everywhere.

units.source_text: 除此以外，再没见一丝生物的影子。

en.t: Apart from that, there was not the slightest trace of any living thing.

units.source_text: 如果说偶尔有什么东西飞来飞去的话，那就是闻到人的汗气尾随而来的牛虻。

en.t: If anything occasionally flew back and forth, it was a horsefly drawn by the smell of human sweat and trailing after him.

units.source_text: 不过，正是在这种环境里，才能够期待有所收获。

en.t: Still, it was precisely in such an environment that one could expect to find something.

units.source_text: 特别是斑蝥一族，它们讨厌群居，最少的时候，甚至一公里见方的范围内，只能见到一只。

en.t: In particular, the blister beetles disliked gathering in groups, and when they were scarce, only one might be found even within a square kilometer.

units.source_text: 所以，只有耐着性子兜圈子找。

en.t: So he had no choice but to patiently circle around and search.
